Title: Vikram's Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Neeta - 56 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Hema - 31 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Suresh - 38 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Pallavi - 29 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vikram stands in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Vikram, what's the plan today?"

[Vikram wraps a bandage around his bleeding hand.]

Neeta (softly): "I'm ready!"

[Vikram presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Vikram: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Vikram stands on the road. Suresh stands near him.]

Suresh: "So, here we are!"

[Vikram's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Vikram (surprised): "Yes, of course."

[Vikram's car crashes into a pole.]

Vikram: "Suresh, look at this."

[A dog runs in front of Vikram's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Vikram: "Well done!"

[Vikram loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Vikram: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Vikram stands by the road. Neeta, Hema and Pallavi stand near him.]

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Vikram rides his motorbike to the market.]

Vikram: "Okay, Hema."

[Vikram starts his scooter and rides off.]

Vikram: "That's great!"

[Vikram rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Pallavi: "This is amazing!"

[Vikram takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Vikram: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vikram's nose is bleeding after the punch.]

Vikram: "Hmm, I see."

[Vikram withdraws cash from the ATM.]

Vikram: "That's great!"

[Vikram wades through the knee-deep water.]

Pallavi: "That was such a fun day!"
